description: This deposit records an experimental Trombe wall installed on a factory in Kalnciems, Latvia, to assess passive solar heating in a cold climate. The research collaborators monitor outdoor and indoor temperatures, wall temperatures at 1.5 and 5 metres, post-fan supply air and incident solar radiation. The article places the campaign in March 2022–July 2023; repository metadata specify ten-minute measurements. Mendeley lists an Excel workbook free under CC BY 4.0, although the article specifications call the raw format CSV. Coverage is one prototype with documented timber framing, polycarbonate glazing and a dark metal backwall. Its temperature gains do not by themselves establish annual building-energy savings or performance at other factories. A reviewer-assessed use is calibrating solar-wall heat-transfer and ventilation components in building simulations. model-energyplus is a related building-energy tool; no matching wall component or import procedure was tested. No measurement file was downloaded.
